settingsTools.intro: The chats have a few built-in tools that an add-on can replace. When the add-on is installed, running and on for a chat, the chat uses the add-on's tool instead, under the same name.
settingsTools.empty: No built-in tool can be managed on this server.
settingsTools.loadFailed: The built-in tools could not be read
settingsTools.installSandbox: Install the Sandbox to run commands isolated
settingsTools.replaceExplain: These add-ons replace {{tool}}: the one chosen serves it in every chat where it is on and running, and the built-in is hidden. Only one can be active.
settingsTools.choose_one: {{count}} add-on replaces {{tool}}: choose which one to use.
settingsTools.choose_other: {{count}} add-ons replace {{tool}}: choose which one to use.

descriptions.bash: Runs commands and code for the chats directly on this machine when no Sandbox serves bash. The Sandbox add-on replaces it with isolated commands.
descriptions.web_search: Searches the web for the chats with DuckDuckGo, or with your SearXNG instance when one is set.
descriptions.web_fetch: Reads a public web page or file by its address for the chats. Addresses inside your network are refused unless you allow them.
descriptions.list_agents: Lets a chat list the user's saved agents and start one as a sub-agent. Each chat switches it on in its Tools menu.

bash.switch: Let chats run commands on this machine
bash.askHint: Only administrators' chats get it, and each command waits for their yes in the chat.
bash.onHint: Every user's chats run commands here without asking, also scheduled runs and sub-agents.
bash.warning: Commands run as the user LocalAI runs as, with no isolation and with this machine's network: they can read what LocalAI can read and reach the internet, your network and the LocalAI API. Every command is logged. Install the Sandbox to isolate them.

settingsTools.skillsIntro: An add-on can replace a built-in skill with its own, written for its tools. When several add-ons replace one, choose the one that serves.
settingsTools.skillNotRunning: The chosen add-on is not running: the built-in skill serves.
